review.brief_reason: The proposed expression is a term-by-term reordering of the original polynomial. All ten terms match exactly: identical decimal literals (e-08/e-09 written as e-8/e-9 are the same values), identical signs (+ -c rewritten as - c), identical variables x1 and x2 with no renaming or permutation, and identical operators (addition, multiplication, exponentiation). Reordering is valid under ordinary real semantics since addition is commutative and associative. Both expressions are total polynomials over the reals, so the domain is unchanged. Structure and term count are identical, so simplicity is the same.
